summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing operational milestones at its Arkansas demonstration plant: processing 1 million barrels of brine from the Smackover Formation, completing 15,000 cycles of direct lithium extraction with 95%+ recovery and 99%+ contaminant rejection, and achieving 340,000 man-hours without a safety incident. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or other special situation is described. This is a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer.
